# v0.1.0 video correction pass — implementation report

**Date:** 2026-11-22 · **Branch:** `develop` · **Version:** still `0.1.0` (development preview, nothing merged or released)
**Inputs:** [three-video audit](../reviews/2026-11-22-three-video-audit.md) · [correction assignment](04-V0.1.0-VIDEO-CORRECTION-PASS.md) · previous [implementation report](03-V0.1.0-IMPLEMENTATION-REPORT.md)

## Update and run on CachyOS (Bash)

Close the Companion first, including any popouts. The tray icon may keep it running, so use its **Quit**.

```bash
cd ~/Documents/PokeMMO-Companion/app        # or wherever you cloned it
git fetch origin && git switch develop && git pull --ff-only
./run.sh                                     # native Qt windows (.venv) or browser mode
./run.sh --spike                             # optional: window feasibility re-check → spike-report.json
```

Your data folder is migrated in place from schema v1 to v2. First a backup copy named `pre-migration-v1-to-v2-*` is written to the backups folder. Runs, step ticks, notes, favourites, settings and reports are kept.

Tests (optional):

```bash
python3 -m pytest -q tests --deselect tests/ui                       # backend
POKEMMO_DUMPS_DIR=~/Documents/PokeMMO-Companion/Pokemmo-Dumps \
CHROME_PATH=/usr/bin/google-chrome python3 -m pytest -q tests/ui     # UI flows (needs playwright)
```

## What changed

### PokeMMO-accurate Pokédex availability
- `companion/data/pokemmo_availability.json` is a **versioned, authored registry** (`2026-11-22.1`). It has a separate `in_game_dex` axis (yes / no / unknown), acquisition classes (wild, gift, fossil, roaming, raid, story_temporary, unavailable …) and evidence levels (OFFICIAL, CORROBORATED, REPORTED, WALKTHROUGH, UNVERIFIED, DUMP_ONLY). Every entry names its source.
- Virizion #640, Tornadus #641, Thundurus #642, Landorus #645 and Keldeo #647 are set to **Not in PokeMMO Pokédex**. The evidence is REPORTED, from the community wiki via the audit.
- Zekrom #644 is `story_temporary`, with evidence OFFICIAL.
- The roaming birds and beasts are `roaming`. Cresselia (raid), the Porygon gift and the fossil lines are classified.
- #638, 639, 643, 646, 648 and 649, plus the other legendaries and mythicals, stay **unknown/UNVERIFIED**. They are not guessed.
- The dump's `obtainable` flag is no longer used to decide availability. Precedence is: your own in-game check > registry > dump wild encounter > dump evolution family > unknown.
- **Default scope is "PokeMMO Dex".** This shows 644 species and hides the 5 reported-absent ones. "All Gen I–V (649)" is a reference view where absent species are dashed and labelled.
- **Roster report.** It compares against the observed in-game denominators from your video: Seen /604, Owned /603, Caught Alpha /362, Costumes /12. 649 − 604 = 45 species are expected to be missing; 5 are identified, so **40 are still to identify**. The app lists them as unknown and does not invent them. You can mark each species "It's listed" or "Not listed" from in-game, and conflicts with the registry are shown.
- **Manual registration tracking per run** (Unregistered / Seen / Owned / Caught OT, plus Alpha / Shiny / Costume flags). It is never presented as account sync. The counters are computed from your marks and are not hardcoded.
- **Detail page** uses PokeMMO's taxonomy: Summary · Moves · Base Stats · Wild Locations · Evolution Tree · Type Matchups. Companion extras (My registration, Breeding, Notes) are separate chips.
- **Grid**: Small / Medium / Large density, registration-coloured borders, silhouettes for unseen species while tracking, and more filters (type slot, ability, held item, stat minimum, class, registration).

### Popouts and window sizes
- The **Pokédex popout has no 60/200 cap**. Compact, Standard and Expanded all render the full filtered list with an "N of M" count.
- **Real size presets per tool and mode** (`companion/data/window_presets.py`), e.g. Pokédex 320×440 / 460×600 / 700×720.
  - Switching modes resizes once and clamps to the screen.
  - After that you can resize freely, and your size is remembered **per mode**.
  - "Reset this mode to its preset size" and "Keep my size when switching modes" are in the mode menu (native) and in Settings › Windows.
- Browser mode applies the same presets with `window.resizeTo` and has a Reset size button.

### Type chart
- Hovering or focusing a cell highlights its **attacking row, defending column and the intersection**, including both headers. A readout reads e.g. "Flying attack → Grass defender: 2× (super effective)".
- Click or Enter locks the selection, Esc clears it, and the arrow keys move it.
- Headers are sticky. There is a legend, a Full chart / Focus one type toggle (compact popouts default to focus), and defensive (two types) and offensive checks. The chart has no Fairy type, matching PokeMMO's Gen V chart.

### Home, Quick access, news
- **Home** is a 12-column responsive grid (breakpoints at 900 / 1100 / 1440 px).
  - The hero shows the latest official update and its top points.
  - Other cards: official news source status, Continue your run, Quick access, Official events, Live (with region/location), More official updates, and Favourites.
  - The blocking onboarding modal is replaced by a **Get started** panel, which also offers detected data to install.
- **Sidebar Quick access** is draggable.
  - Pin tools, Pokémon, guides or pages with the pin buttons, or drag tool cards and Pokédex cards onto the sidebar.
  - Reorder by dragging or with Alt+↑/↓; remove with Delete or the context menu.
  - It is saved in settings and appears as a strip in horizontal navigation.
- **Automatic official news checks.**
  - The first check runs 20 s after launch, then every 3 h by default (Settings › Sources, 1–24 h, can be switched off).
  - Fetches are conditional (ETag / If-Modified-Since); manual "Check now" is limited to once per 60 s.
  - Edited titles are detected and marked. New posts show "Summary pending verification" until a summary is written.
  - A failed check keeps the last items and shows the error.

### Live notifications
- The default subscription is `alphapings,swarmpings`. The kind comes from the topic; species, region and location come from the real Alphapedia payload shapes ("Ditto" / "Kanto, Cerulean Cave"). The Alphapedia link is kept when present.
- Toasts now default to the **top-right** corner, for new profiles only; an existing choice is kept. Titles include the location.

### Docs fix
- The README link to the 03 report was broken because `.gitignore`'s `build/` rule also ignored `docs/build/`, so the 03 report was never committed. The rule is now anchored (`/build/`), and 03 and this report are committed. README links point explicitly at `develop`.

### Data install
- A **read-only auto-detect** checks only known folders: Documents/PokeMMO-Companion, Documents/Pokemmo-Dumps, Downloads, the Flatpak `com.pokemmo.PokeMMO` data folder, `~/.local/share/pokemmo-client-live`, `~/PokeMMO`, `~/Games/PokeMMO`.
- Both zip and already-extracted dump folders are recognised. Nothing is installed until you click **Install**.
- Fingerprints detect a newer dump ("Update available"). Original files are never modified or moved, and nothing from the dumps is committed to Git.

## Test results (this pass, cloud workspace)

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| Backend + golden dump (`POKEMMO_DUMPS_DIR` set) | **134 passed** |
| Backend without dumps | 120 passed, 14 skipped (dump-only) |
| UI flows, Playwright + Chrome, with dumps | **17 passed** (three consecutive clean runs) |
| UI flows without dumps | 15 passed, 2 skipped |
| Qt shell wiring (mocked PySide6 stub) | passed (toast limit, quit) |

The new tests cover:
- the registry (the five absent species, 644, roamers, user-check precedence and conflict) and the roster report numbers;
- per-run registration counts and the backup round-trip;
- the v1→v2 migration with backup;
- window presets and clamping, size and Quick access validation;
- news merging, edits, throttling and failed checks;
- the auto-detect folder limits and the real ntfy payload shapes;
- in the UI: the Pokédex popout full list in all three modes (scrolls to #649), the type-chart crosshair, lock, arrow keys and Esc, Quick access pin/reorder/drag/unpin and persistence in both navigation modes, Home without a modal, and registration silhouettes and counts.

One UI run (out of five) had an intermittent timeout in the existing two-runs/restart Guides test. It did not reproduce afterwards.

## Still unverified — please check in the next video
1. **The native Qt shell on your KDE/CachyOS desktop.** Mode-switch resizing, remembered per-mode sizes, "keep my size", and the clamp to screen were only exercised with a mocked PySide6 here.
2. **The remaining 40 species** missing from the in-game 604. Use **Roster report** and mark species "Not listed" as you find them. The five REPORTED absences are also still to be confirmed against your own in-game Pokédex.
3. **Live ntfy.** Parsing was tested against recorded payload shapes only; no live alpha or swarm was captured in this pass.
4. **Automatic news fetching against the real forum.** The forum was not reachable from the build workspace. Conditional requests, 304 handling and edit detection are tested only with mocks.
5. **Auto-detect on your real folders** (Flatpak path and Documents layout) and the Install button with your files.
6. Windows (`run.ps1`) is untested. The Better Default palette is still sampled from screenshots.
7. Legendary/mythical availability marked UNVERIFIED stays that way until a source is added.

## Suggested next-video walkthrough
1. Launch and confirm that Home shows no modal, that the Get started panel appears, and that the Install banner appears if your dumps are in Documents.
2. **Pokédex:** check the "644 of 644 shown" line and the roster report. Open Virizion in the "All Gen I–V" view, then Zekrom and a roaming bird. Compare 3–4 species against the in-game Pokédex tabs.
3. Pick a run in **Registration tracking**, mark a few species, and compare the counters with the in-game counters.
4. **Pokédex popout:** switch Compact → Standard → Expanded, resize one, switch away and back, then use Reset. Scroll to #649 in each mode.
5. **Type chart:** hover Flying → Grass, lock it, use the arrow keys, then Esc. Open the compact popout (focus view).
6. **Quick access:** drag a tool from Tools and a Pokémon from the Pokédex into the sidebar, reorder, remove, then restart.
7. **Settings › Sources:** look at the auto-check status, then click Check now twice to show the throttle.
8. If a ping arrives, check the top-right toast shows the region and location.
